kokoreva2009.locator: Author abstract, Materials and methods, printed pp. 6-7; model parameterization and sensitivity sections
kokoreva2009.decision: Methods distinguish absorption measurements and parameterized models; no exact table binding for workbook AB33:AB71 established. Full dissertation not used.

tymbaev2004.locator: Author abstract, Objects and methods; spatial variability of absorption; SWAP modeling
tymbaev2004.decision: Both laboratory/field properties and model inputs discussed; exact origin of AB87 not established. Full dissertation not used.

umarova2008.locator: Primary author abstract reproduced in HTML, Table 2, gray forest soil profiles
umarova2008.decision: Particle density and total porosity labels, units and profile/depth identity corroborated. Particle-density preparation/protocol and porosity measured-versus-derived origin not specified in that table. Workbook V81 is an Excel datetime; no repair authorized.

makarychev2014.locator: Original article pp. 35-39, Figure 1 and methods paragraph
makarychev2014.decision: Figure labels soil and solid-phase density in g/cm3. Workbook precision suggests digitization; exact point/horizon and preparation protocol not established for release.

predictor_decisions.particle_density: Partial corroboration at master V77:V80,V83,V85 from Umarova Table 2; method and dry-soil preparation unreported. V81 datetime rejected. Makarychev3 V206:V209 lacks exact figure-point provenance. Other sources: quantity label only, source-specific unit/method/material unresolved. No assumed density. All retained candidates still lack compatible sand/silt for Saxton1986.
predictor_decisions.porosity: Master U and thesis X mix potential percent/fraction scales; no global rescaling. Additional master Z421 and thesis AK41 porosity headers have fraction-like numeric blocks, but their scale, saturation/total-pore meaning and measured/model-derived origin remain unresolved. Umarova Table 2 distinguishes total, aggregate and interaggregate porosity. Reported total labels are corroborated but measured/derived origin unresolved. Effective porosity is a different contract. Existing exploratory percent policy is preserved as historical policy, not upgraded by this review.
predictor_decisions.total_porosity: Same candidates as porosity; no synonym binding authorized. Density-derived total porosity requires two independently confirmed same-sample dry-soil measurements in matching units/material. No candidate pair has a complete new preparation/protocol contract; no new derivation released.
predictor_decisions.ph: Master T and thesis W: numeric pH candidates, but H2O/KCl/CaCl2, extraction ratio and measurement origin are not recorded. No numeric pH candidate overlaps retained canonical WRC samples. Kalumba requires 1:5 soil-to-water; generic Hodnett/Tiwary contracts do not prove workbook measurement origin. No guessed method.
predictor_decisions.nitrogen: Thesis AE1 is specific surface measured by nitrogen adsorption, not nitrogen concentration. No numeric values below AE1. No reviewed total/mineral N measurement, dry-mass basis or percentage unit. Kalumba nitrogen contract remains unsatisfied.
predictor_decisions.clay_content: Master M/thesis P physical clay below 10 micrometres is not Bruand below-2-micrometre clay. Master N/thesis Q default below 1 micrometre, with source-local overrides including Q32 below 2. No source-global relabeling; Bruand clay-fabric/domain support is additionally sample-specific and unresolved.
predictor_decisions.depth: Existing explicit interval midpoint policy retained. Thesis M includes numeric depths, intervals with cm and intervals without a unit; no new unit or profile inheritance. Depth cannot repair source/sample mismatch.
predictor_decisions.carbon: Existing OC/humus alias policies remain exploratory with conversion provenance. Thesis U is OC whereas master U is porosity; never transfer by column letter. Formula-derived humus is not an independent measured predictor.
predictor_decisions.plasticity: Thesis AF/AG contain numeric plastic/liquid-limit candidates, including Nikulina and Faustova. Previous blanket absence of 17 plasticity functions is retracted. Exact source/table identity, dry-mass water units and protocol remain unresolved; no plasticity target released. AC is heat of wetting, not filtration.
